node: Optical interconnect, photonics components, InP devices, lasers, photodetectors, and precision substrates for 800G/1.6T AI data-center networks
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around AI optical photonics bottlenecks with a two-lane funnel. Reference names are Coherent and Lumentum because they sit directly in InP lasers, optical components, and AI datacenter photonics supply. The underfollowed lane adds Fabrinet as a contract-manufacturing / production-capacity beneficiary and Aeluma as a speculative shadow candidate for alternative III-V-on-silicon photodetector or photonics scaling. The core chokepoint hypothesis remains that 800G/1.6T AI datacenter optical demand may be constrained not only by transceiver module vendors but by qualified InP devices, photodetectors, substrates, and manufacturing qualification cycles.
